_comment: TINK F313 — per-kind declarations consumed by `stone` (skills/workflow/scripts/stone). DAS-side, vault-wide: every anchor and every agent must agree on what a control file is named and how a stone line renders, so this lives beside the facet specs (DAS Stone.md, DAS Stone Design.md, DAS Stone Keys.md) rather than in ~/.config/. Format keys: {slug} in folder/control/aliases; {link} in the optional header_line template (default '{link}'), which wraps the assembled `[[{control}|{header_alias}]]` wikilink. NOTE 2026-08-17: the dashes-OUTSIDE form (header_alias '{slug}' + header_line '-{link}-') was tried and REVERTED — a bare `-[[X Pebble|X]]-` line is HookAnchor's electric identity-row grammar, and ELECTRIC rebuilds wiped every line below the header in 54 control files. The dashes stay INSIDE the display (`[[X Pebble|-X-]]`), which renders the same and does not match that grammar. 'control' MUST be of the exact shape '{slug} WORD' — stone's header/self-section detection derives the fixed WORD suffix from it.
